name: After § 19
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 19a. Stresses that delivering the Clean Industrial Deal at the necessary scale requires substantial additional public investment that cannot be accommodated within the current ceilings of the multiannual financial framework; calls, therefore, for the establishment of a dedicated EU-level investment facility for industrial decarbonisation and competitiveness, backed by common EU debt instruments, to provide predictable, long-term financing for industry-wide transformation, resilience and job protection;
